text: OVERDOSAGE Signs and symptoms of an overdose may include: nausea, vomiting, and neurotoxic effects, including ataxia, confusion, disorientation, seizures and peripheral neuropathy. Treatment of Overdosage Symptomatic treatment is recommended. There is no specific antidote for an overdose of metronidazole. Discontinue metronidazole administration in the event of an overdose. Hemodialysis removes significant amounts of metronidazole and its metabolites from systemic circulation.
